segments.title: New HometownFilter component, modified TrainersPage, useTrainers and fetchTrainers

traceDiagram.title: Load and filter trainers flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the trainers page loads the trainers of a hometown through `useTrainers()` and renders them in a table. It also shows what happens when the user types a hometown, and how the hometown reaches the trainers request through `fetchTrainers()`.

traceNodes.label: Shows the trainers tab or the items tab
traceNodes.description: When the user opens the app, `main.tsx` renders this component inside `StrictMode`.

children.label: Lists the trainers of the chosen hometown
children.description: When the user opens the app, [`App` renders this page](code:src/App.tsx#L20) because `tab` starts as `"trainers"`. When the user types in the hometown field, `changeHometown()` stores the new hometown, and the page renders again with it.

children.label: Shows the hometown field
children.description: When `TrainersPage` renders, [it renders this component](code:src/pages/trainers/TrainersPage.tsx#L16) with the hometown it keeps and with `changeHometown()` as `onHometownChange`.

triggerLabels.label: A user types in the hometown field
A user types in the hometown field

blockLabels.label: Keeps the hometown the user typed
Gets the trainers of the hometown and whether they still load
Renders one row for each trainer

traceNodes.label: Loads the trainers of one hometown
traceNodes.description: When `TrainersPage` renders, [it calls this hook with its hometown](code:src/pages/trainers/TrainersPage.tsx#L8). After each render with a new hometown, React runs [the effect of the hook](code:src/hooks/use-trainers.ts#L9-14), and the effect calls `fetchTrainers()`.

blockLabels.label: Requests the trainers again each time the hometown changes

traceNodes.label: Requests the trainers of a hometown from the API
traceNodes.description: When the hometown of `TrainersPage` changes, [the effect of `useTrainers()` calls this function](code:src/hooks/use-trainers.ts#L11) with the hometown.

blockLabels.label: Builds the hometown query, or an empty query for an empty hometown

traceNodes.label: Stores the typed hometown without spaces at its ends
traceNodes.description: When the user types in the hometown field, [`HometownFilter` calls `onHometownChange()`](code:src/pages/trainers/components/HometownFilter.tsx#L12) with the value of the field, and `TrainersPage` passes `changeHometown()` as `onHometownChange`.

blockLabels.label: Takes the value of the hometown field
Stores the trimmed value as the hometown

traceNodes.label: Passes the typed value to the page
traceNodes.description: When the user types in the hometown field, `Input` calls this handler with the change event, and the handler calls `onHometownChange()` of `TrainersPage` with `event.target.value`.
